# Topology.MoveAPI.search_neighbors

Exports: `Topology.MoveAPI.search_neighbors`, `Topology.search_neighbors`

## `search_neighbors(store::MoveGraphStoreDB, ::Type{HeegaardCode}, state_id::AbstractString; row_ids=nothing) -> Vector`

    search_neighbors(store::MoveGraphStoreDB, ::Type{HeegaardCode}, state_id::AbstractString; row_ids=nothing) -> Vector

Read the stored outgoing edges of an HC presentation in the search graph.

# Arguments
`store` satisfies M7 of the [search-store conditions](../../specs/move-graph-store.md#numbered-conditions);
`state_id` is the source presentation's stored identifier.
Checked: the HC schema must be installed and supported; `ArgumentError` names
the absent schema or unsupported version. Database and string-conversion errors
propagate. `row_ids` is absent or an iterable of move-row names.
Caller's responsibility: trust the stored certificates only to the extent
they have been independently verified.

# Returns
Records containing `operation_id`, `run_id`, source and target state IDs,
`depth`, `row_id`, `inverse_status`, and decoded `candidate` data.

# Guarantees
1. Only stored successful outgoing HC edges matching the requested row names
   are returned, ordered by depth, row name and operation ID. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. Database records are not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
This does not enumerate unstored moves or recheck equivalence of manifolds.
An empty result is compatible with undiscovered neighbors.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/module-structure.md §3.1 — representation-selected search interface.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> s = open_store(); Topology.HeegaardCodes.migrate_hc_search_store!(s);

julia> isempty(search_neighbors(s, Topology.HeegaardCodes.HeegaardCode, "absent"; row_ids=String[]))
true

julia> close_store!(s);
```

## `search_neighbors(store::MoveGraphStoreDB, ::Type{VirtualLink}, state_id::AbstractString; kinds=("MP", "02")) -> Vector`

    search_neighbors(store::MoveGraphStoreDB, ::Type{VirtualLink}, state_id::AbstractString; kinds=("MP", "02")) -> Vector

Read the stored outgoing edges of an o-graph presentation in the search graph.

# Arguments
Use the store, identifier and kind conditions of
[`ograph_search_neighbors`](ograph_search_neighbors.md) and the [search specification](../../specs/ograph-search-db.md#contract).
The store requires M7 of the [store conditions](../../specs/move-graph-store.md#numbered-conditions).
Checked: unsupported move kinds raise `ArgumentError`; schema and database
errors propagate. The caller supplies a readable store and interprets its
stored evidence independently of this query.

# Returns
The neighbor records of `ograph_search_neighbors`, including operation and
endpoint IDs, kind, direction, engine version and candidate JSON.

# Guarantees
1. The returned rows equal `ograph_search_neighbors(store,state_id; kinds)`.
   These are stored successful directed operations, not newly generated moves. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. The store is not modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
The call does not replay transitions or establish manifold equivalence.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/ograph-search-db.md §Contract — the persisted presentation graph.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> s = open_store(); migrate_ograph_search_store!(s);

julia> isempty(search_neighbors(s, VirtualLink, "absent"; kinds=String[]))
true

julia> close_store!(s);
```

## `search_neighbors(store::MoveGraphStoreDB, state_id::AbstractString; kinds=("MP", "02")) -> Vector{NamedTuple}`

    search_neighbors(store::MoveGraphStoreDB, state_id::AbstractString; kinds=("MP", "02")) -> Vector{NamedTuple}

Read stored outgoing o-graph moves through the common move API.

# Arguments
Use a readable search store and a state ID. `kinds` must contain only MP,
literal 02 or PS; unsupported kinds throw `ArgumentError`. Database errors
propagate. Empty kinds and absent sources return empty vectors.

# Returns
The rows of [`ograph_search_neighbors`](ograph_search_neighbors.md), carrying operation ID,
endpoint IDs, move kind, direction, engine version and candidate JSON.

# Guarantees
1. The result equals `ograph_search_neighbors(store, state_id; kinds)`:
   only successful stored operations, sorted by move kind and operation ID.
   Database rows are unchanged. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. These are directed edges of the [unweighted presentation graph](../../specs/ograph-search-db.md#contract),
   with no new mathematical certification. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
The call does not generate neighbors, replay edges or certify manifold
equivalence. Empty output does not prove there are no possible moves.

# Sources
cf: lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/ograph-search-db.md §Workflow — the persisted directed geometric graph.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> Base.include(@__MODULE__, joinpath(pkgdir(Topology), "examples", "VLExample.jl"));

julia> store = open_store(); migrate_ograph_search_store!(store); v = vl_example("s2xs1"); s = put_ograph_search_state!(store, v);

julia> r = begin_ograph_search_run!(store, joinpath(pkgdir(Topology), "test", "ograph_search_db.jl"); label="literal-02-smoke"); expand_ograph_search_state!(store, r, v, "02"; selector=Dict("direction" => "forward"));

julia> all(String(e.move_kind) == "02" for e in Topology.MoveAPI.search_neighbors(store, s.state_id; kinds=("02",)))
true

julia> close_store!(store);
```

See also [`ograph_search_neighbors`](ograph_search_neighbors.md), [`query_ograph_search_paths`](query_ograph_search_paths.md).

## `search_neighbors(store::MoveGraphStoreDB, presentation::Union{Type{HeegaardCode},Type{VirtualLink}}, state_id::AbstractString; kwargs...) -> Vector`

    search_neighbors(store::MoveGraphStoreDB, presentation::Union{Type{HeegaardCode},Type{VirtualLink}}, state_id::AbstractString; kwargs...) -> Vector

Read successful outgoing transitions from a presentation-specific stored search graph.

# Arguments
`presentation` is `HeegaardCode` or `VirtualLink`; omission selects o-graphs.
Requires M7 ([conditions](../../specs/move-graph-store.md#numbered-conditions)).
HC accepts `row_ids=nothing` or an iterable of names convertible to strings;
its schema is checked. VirtualLink accepts `kinds=("MP","02")`; unsupported
kinds raise `ArgumentError` naming MP, 02 and PS. Empty filters give no rows.
The state ID need not exist. Conversion, decoding and database errors propagate.

# Returns
HC records have operation/run/source/target IDs, depth, row ID, inverse
status and decoded candidate. O-graph rows are the successful-edge records
of `ograph_search_neighbors`, including kind, direction, engine version and
encoded candidate. See [Search-run provenance](../../specs/move-graph-store.md#search-run-provenance).

# Guarantees
1. Results equal the selected `hc_search_neighbors` or `ograph_search_neighbors` query for the supplied source and filters. [proved/agent: by construction]
2. HC results are ordered by depth, row ID and operation ID; o-graph results by kind and operation ID. [proved/agent: by construction]
3. Neither store nor arguments are modified. [proved/agent: by construction]

# Not guaranteed
The query neither generates moves nor replays stored edges. An empty result
does not imply that the mathematical state has no neighbors.

# Sources
cf:lib/topology.jl/docs/specs/move-graph-store.md Search-run provenance — recorded directed transitions.

# Examples
```jldoctest
julia> s = open_store(); migrate_ograph_search_store!(s);

julia> isempty(Topology.MoveAPI.search_neighbors(s, VirtualLink, "absent"; kinds=String[]))
true

julia> close_store!(s);
```
